title: One Sentence Now Creates a Semester of Calendar Events | vitalii.no
description:
When you dictated a weekly recurring event to the calendar bot, the language model itself had to spell out every single date in the series. For anything spanning a half-year, it would try to list every date, break its own JSON output, and the bot would just answer back with a bare 'Помилка обробки' (processing error) — no clue what had actually gone wrong.

The fix moves date-series expansion out of the language model and into the server. The dictated action now carries just a repeat field — which weekdays, and an until date — and a loop in server.ts walks day by day in UTC, applying a timezone offset fix to keep local time correct across the DST change. A related bug got fixed in the same pass: the check for dictation that is too long for the model was counting characters instead of bytes, so Cyrillic text could sneak past it and still get rejected upstream.

A single sentence like 'every Tuesday until June' now reliably creates the whole series, and the half-year processing-error failure is gone. The runaway case is still covered: the series is capped at 200 rows, so one mis-dictated 'forever' can't spiral out of control.
